description: Find open-source robot kits by words, type or budget. Returns up to 10 robots with the lowest in-stock USD price, stock state, license and page link. Call with no arguments to list everything.

query.description: Words such as 'humanoid', 'desktop', '3d printed arm' or a robot name

type.description: arm, humanoid, desktop, biped, dog or cable

name: search_robots
